 OAKLAND PARK, Fla. (Gambling911.com) - Goalscorer betting markets are available for Tuesday's Serie A match between Venezia and Inter Milan.
 Players to Watch 
 Marcus Thuram has terrific value coming into today's match as he will pay out even odds with an anytime goal. 
 Thurman has scored in three consecutive Serie A appearances, against Parma, Bologna and Fiorentina. His latest outing against Fiorentina was especially active: nine shots, four on target and one goal.
 Ange-Yoan Bonny scored against Udinese on September 14 and Bologna on October 17 but has been somewhat limited of late. 
 He also pays even odds to score a goal in today's match. 
 Francesco Pio Esposito scored against Udinese on September 14 but has gone four subsequent Serie A appearances without a goal.
 He also pays even odds to score in this one. 
 There is an argument to be had as to why all three of these players do have value in the goalscorer market.
 Venezia are conceding an average of 2.00 goals in their home games (Serie A) while Inter has scored 2+ goals in their last six Serie A matches.
